audit.why: Kit: Crescent Strike 8s rank 1, Pale Cascade 15s rank 1 (shield), Lunar Rush 22s but free onto Moonlight targets, Moonfall 100/90/80s. The Moonlight-reset is the interaction that decides chasing and dodging.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers written in; wants.you[1] slot corrected; Pale Cascade left as-is and recorded here.
